1	# CreativeHub — Online courses for creative professionals
     2	
     3	## Brand
     4	CreativeHub is the largest creative learning community offering thousands of online courses taught by world-class professionals in design, illustration, photography, crafts, and more. The platform empowers creative professionals, designers, illustrators, photographers, and hobbyists to learn new skills at their own pace through high-quality video instruction and a vibrant community.
     5	
     6	Brand colors: #F02D00 (primary red-orange), #171717 (dark foreground), #FFFFFF (white)
     7	
     8	Tone: Bold, modern, professional
     9	
    10	## Featured Specializations
    11	Carousel of featured specialization bundles displayed on the homepage hero section. Each includes title, description, student count, rating, original price, and discounted price.
    12	
    13	| Specialization | Description | Students | Rating | Original | Sale Price |
    14	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
    15	| Graphic Design and Visual Communication | Master color, composition, and visual perception to create impactful and coherent visual identities. | 26,264 | 100% (337) | $94.99 | $0.50 |
    16	| Sewing and Design Specialization | Master sewing techniques: from using a sewing machine to creating garments like dresses, trousers, and backpacks. | 16,058 | 100% (69) | $94.99 | $0.50 |
    17	| Social Media Marketing Specialization | Learn to design, manage, and execute effective social media campaigns with targeted objectives and performance analytics. | 12,900 | 99% (73) | $94.99 | $0.50 |
    18	| Sketching Techniques Specialization | Explore the power of sketching alongside top-notch drawing masters. | 12,796 | 99% (129) | $94.99 | $0.50 |
    19	| UX/UI Design Specialization | Create engaging digital experiences with UX design through research, methodology, and strategy for your portfolio. | 8,880 | 100% (81) | $94.99 | $0.50 |
    20	
    21	All specializations are labeled "FREE WITH" (Plus membership) and show 99% discount badges.
    22	
    23	## Best Seller Courses
    24	Grid of best-selling courses with course title, instructor, student count, rating, price, and "Best seller" badge.
    25	
    26	- **Drawing for Beginners Level -1** — by Puño · 274,195 students · 99% (10.47K) · $0.50 (was $29.99)
    27	- **Modern Watercolor Techniques** — by Ana Victoria Calderon · 228,801 students · 99% (10.21K) · $0.50
    28	- **Professional Photography for Instagram** — by Mina Barrio · 282,895 students · 99% (10.89K) · $0.50
    29	- **Creative Drawing Techniques for Beginners** — by Puño · 177,842 students · 99% (4.52K) · $0.50
    30	- **Introduction to After Effects** — by Carlos "Zenzuke" Albarrán · 296,236 students · 97% (4.93K) · $0.50
    31	- **Introduction to Adobe Photoshop** — by Carles Marsal · 381,277 students · 100% (10.16K) · $0.50
    32	
    33	## Course Engagement Stats
    34	Key metrics displayed on course cards across the platform:
    35	
    36	- **274,195** — student enrollments (Drawing for Beginners)
    37	- **99%** — average satisfaction rating
    38	- **$0.50** — promotional course price
    39	- **98% Disc.** — typical discount percentage shown
    40	- **282,895** — student enrollments (Professional Photography for Instagram)
    41	
    42	## Platform Value Propositions
    43	Section title: "What to expect from a CreativeHub course"
    44	
    45	- **Learn at your own pace** — Enjoy learning from home without a set schedule and with an easy-to-follow method. You set your own pace.
    46	- **Get front-row seats** — Videos of the highest quality, so you don't miss a single detail. With unlimited access, you can watch them as many times as you need to perfect your technique.
    47	- **Learn from the best professionals** — Learn valuable methods and techniques explained by top experts in the creative sector.
    48	- **Share knowledge and ideas** — Ask questions, request feedback, or offer solutions. Share your learning experience with other students in the community.
    49	- **Meet expert teachers** — Each expert teaches what they do best, with clear guidelines, true passion, and professional insight in every lesson.
    50	- **Connect with a global creative community** — The community is home to millions of people from around the world who are curious and passionate about exploring and expressing their creativity.
    51	- **Earn a certificate with every course (Plus)** — Get a custom certificate signed by your teacher for every course. Share it on your portfolio or social media.
    52	- **Watch professionally produced courses** — CreativeHub curates its teacher roster and produces every course in-house to ensure a high-quality online learning experience.
    53	
    54	## Course Categories
    55	Sidebar navigation listing all course categories with sub-sections for Areas and Software filters.
    56	
    57	**Categories:** Illustration · Craft · Marketing & Business · Photography & Video · Design · 3D & Animation · Architecture & Spaces · Writing · Fashion · Web & App Design · Calligraphy & Typography · Music & Audio · Culinary · Artificial Intelligence · Wellness
    58	
    59	**Areas:** Branding & Identity · Graphic Design · Social Media Design · Web Design · Color Theory · Traditional Illustration · Digital Illustration · Drawing · Arts & Crafts · Fine Arts · Photography · Marketing · Painting
    60	
    61	**Software:** Canva · Adobe Photoshop · Adobe Illustrator · Procreate · Adobe After Effects · SketchUp · Cinema 4D · Figma · Blender
    62	
    63	**Course Types:** All courses · Guided courses · Deep Dive · Specializations · Basics · New courses · Top rated · Popular courses
    64	
    65	## Subscription Pricing
    66	Toggle between Yearly and Monthly plans.
    67	
    68	| Detail | Yearly | Monthly |
    69	|---|---|---|
    70	| Price | $14.59/month | $33.90/month |
    71	| Billed as | $174.50/year | $33.90/month |
    72	| Savings | **SAVE 57%** | — |
    73	| Plus credits | 12 per year | 1 per month |
    74	
    75	Terms: Cancel subscription renewal whenever you want. After one year, renewal price will be the full amount of $349.
    76	
    77	## Plus Membership Benefits
    78	- **+1,000 courses FREE** — Watch thousands of courses for free across Illustration, Photography, Crafts, Marketing, Design, Architecture, Web & App Design, and more.
    79	- **100+ new courses added every week** — Choose from a catalog of courses that Plus subscribers can watch for free for at least 30 days.
    80	- **12 annual credits** — Receive credits to redeem for any course on the platform. Use them immediately or save for later.
    81	- **Certificate per course** — When you complete a purchased course, instantly get your personalized certificate signed by the teacher.
    82	- **Exchange it now, or later** — Use your credits as soon as you get them or save them. You have a whole year.
    83	- **Get exclusive savings** — Buy credits and use them to pay for courses. Always save at least 20%.
    84	
    85	## Plus FAQ
    86	Expandable accordion with questions and answers about the Plus subscription.
    87	
    88	- **What courses can Plus members watch for free?** — Plus members can watch thousands of courses for free, with 100+ new courses added to the Plus catalog every week. Courses are free to watch for a limited time period. You can always buy a course to keep it forever.
    89	- **How do Plus credits work?** — You'll get one credit each month (monthly) or 12 credits per year (annual), starting the day you subscribe. Credits accumulate and can be exchanged for any course regardless of price. Credits expire one year after receipt or when membership ends. Once redeemed, the course is yours forever.
    90	- **When will I get my certificate?** — When you complete a purchased course, you'll instantly get your personalized certificate. Download as PDF or share online. Includes your name, course title, QR code linking to your project, and teacher's signature.
    91	- **What's the difference between the yearly and monthly subscription?** — Benefits are exactly the same, but the yearly payment offers a 14% discount.
    92	
    93	## Featured Projects
    94	Masonry-style gallery of community projects with thumbnails, usernames, like counts, and view counts.
    95

    98	- **Wonder Woman** — @gatol26 · 11 likes · 252 views
